connection_condition: Examination.ID carries the value of Patient.ID for the patient the examination belongs to
description: A patient is composed of examination events; an examination record has no meaning without the patient it describes.

connection_condition: Laboratory.ID carries the value of Patient.ID for the patient the panel belongs to
description: A patient is composed of laboratory records; every laboratory record in the environment resolves to a patient through its identifier.

connection_condition: the two record families are connected only through a shared patient identifier, and only 20 identifiers are common to both in this environment
description: Examination events and laboratory panels describe the same patient at different times but are not directly linked to one another.

connection_condition: the event class corresponds to the grades 1, 2 and 3, a proper subset of the codes 0, 1, 2 and 3
description: A thrombotic event is the instance class of examination records whose thrombosis grade is greater than zero; its value domain is a subset of the full grade domain.

connection_condition: the same clinical phenomenon is expressed either as the ordinal Thrombosis code or as free text in the Symptoms field and in the Diagnosis labels, without a guaranteed one-to-one record alignment
description: The ordinal thrombosis code and the textual thrombotic manifestation are two representations of the same clinical phenomenon; they overlap in meaning but not necessarily in record coverage.

connection_condition: the symptom text is populated exactly on the examination records whose thrombosis grade is greater than zero
description: The recorded symptom description accompanies the presence of a thrombotic event and characterises its clinical form.
Lupus anticoagulant is one specific type of antiphospholipid antibody determination within the antiphospholipid antibody family.
Anticardiolipin antibody is one specific type of antiphospholipid antibody determination within the antiphospholipid antibody family.

connection_condition: LAC is the qualitative determination while KCT and RVVT are the phospholipid-dependent clotting assays recorded alongside it; they agree in most but not all records
description: The recorded lupus anticoagulant result and the phospholipid-dependent clotting assay results are related determinations of the same antiphospholipid activity but are not interchangeable: 17 records are positive for lupus anticoagulant with both assays unperformed and 2 are positive with both assays negative.

connection_condition: both are recorded on the same examination record, so their co-occurrence can be compared within examination records
description: Antiphospholipid antibody determinations and recorded thrombotic events are clinically related and are jointly recorded on examination records, which is what makes a within-record comparison possible.

connection_condition: connection must pass through the shared patient identifier, which is common to only a small number of patients
description: Coagulation and fibrinolysis measurements characterise haemostatic activity that is expected to relate to thrombotic events, but they are recorded in a different table and cannot be joined to an examination event directly.

connection_condition: connection must pass through the shared patient identifier
description: Platelet count is a haemostatic quantity expected to relate to thrombotic events, recorded in the laboratory table at dates independent of the examination event.

connection_condition: both values are recorded on the same examination record
description: An antinuclear antibody titre and its staining pattern are recorded together on an examination record and are interpretable only in combination.

connection_condition: both occur on the same examination record for the examination diagnosis, and can otherwise be related only through the shared patient identifier
description: Antinuclear antibody titre is a serological expression of the autoimmune disease context in which the examination was performed.

connection_condition: connection must pass through the shared patient identifier
description: Extractable nuclear antigen autoantibody specificities are serological markers associated with the autoimmune disease groups recorded as diagnoses.

connection_condition: connection must pass through the shared patient identifier
description: Anti-double-stranded-DNA antibody is a serological marker associated with autoimmune disease diagnosis groups.

connection_condition: connection must pass through the shared patient identifier
description: Complement component levels are laboratory markers associated with autoimmune disease activity and diagnosis groups.

connection_condition: connection must pass through the shared patient identifier
description: C-reactive protein is an acute-phase marker associated with the inflammatory activity of the recorded autoimmune disease.

connection_condition: connection must pass through the shared patient identifier
description: Urinary protein is a laboratory marker of renal involvement associated with the recorded autoimmune disease.

connection_condition: the age is computed from the patient birth date against the first visit date
description: Age at first visit is derived from the patient birth date and the first visit date; it does not exist as a stored value.
